# Fred de Ruiter

> Portfolio of Fred de Ruiter, a clinical data engineer. Interactive studios for clinical forms, formal proofs and neuroimaging, a playable arcade, and engineering case studies with architectural write-ups.

Canonical origin: https://deruiter.dev. The full architectural dossier, with case-study abstracts and trade-offs, is at [llms-full.txt](https://deruiter.dev/llms-full.txt).

## Systems and studios

- [Open Source Credits and Licenses](https://deruiter.dev/acknowledgments): The open source projects this site is built on, each linked to its home, with versions, licenses and why it is used. Full license texts are included.
- [CRF Studio: Clinical Form Designer](https://deruiter.dev/crf): Build clinical research forms, add validation rules, and try them with sample data. Explore a browser-based study designer by Fred de Ruiter.
- [NeuroRecon Studio: Brain Viewer](https://deruiter.dev/neuro): Explore brain surfaces and MRI slices, place control points, and work through simulated reconstruction problems in a FreeSurfer-style pipeline simulator.
- [Ski Patrol Shift Studio Simulation](https://deruiter.dev/patrol): An interactive Midwest ski-patrol judgment simulation foundation powered by deterministic FSM transitions and operational dispatch routines.
- [Logical Proof Workspace: Step by Step](https://deruiter.dev/proof): Build a proof one step at a time. Connect premises, try inference rules, and inspect where an argument goes wrong. Export finished proofs to Lean 4 or LaTeX.
- [Architectural Archetype Simulator](https://deruiter.dev/simulator): Pick an architecture bias, triage a production latency spike and review an async pipeline, then see which architectural archetype your trade-offs map to.
- [Under the Hood: How This Site Works](https://deruiter.dev/stack): See how this site works: text layout, browser audio, the application stack, and the checks I use while building it. Demos and source included.

## Arcade

- [Arcade: Browser Games and Puzzles](https://deruiter.dev/arcade): Try browser games by Fred de Ruiter: a laser loon, a demanding puppy, logic puzzles, clinical trial games, and a smartwatch with little memory to spare.
- [Clinical Trial Chaos: SDTM Game](https://deruiter.dev/arcade/clinical-chaos): Sort clinical data into SDTM domains, sign the submissions, and keep up with the conveyor belt while the auditor watches. At least there is a restart button.
- [Monkey C Mayhem: Garmin Schvitz App](https://deruiter.dev/arcade/garmin-watch): Keep a simulated smartwatch running within a 32KB memory budget. Dodge obstacles, clear memory, and wipe the screen when it fogs up in Monkey C Mayhem.
- [Laser Loon: Quest for the State Flag](https://deruiter.dev/arcade/laser-loon): Fly F277 Laser Loon through four campaign acts from Lake Minnetonka to the State Capitol dome, blasting rival flags and red tape in this browser game.
- [Meme Vault: Soundboard and Trophies](https://deruiter.dev/arcade/meme-vault): Make some noise with a synthesized browser soundboard, discover hidden trophies, and enjoy a few jokes about code, clinical data, and the working day.
- [Protocol Drift: Data Pipeline Sim](https://deruiter.dev/arcade/protocol-drift): A browser-first systems-engineering puzzle simulation exploring the friction between ideal regulatory specifications and messy human clinical data collection.
- [Formal Verification Puzzler Game](https://deruiter.dev/arcade/quasi-puzzler): Apply deductive proof tactics to a tree in this Lean-inspired puzzle game and reach a complete proof. Skipping a goal with “sorry” costs you score.
- [Retro Labyrinth: Graveyard Roguelike](https://deruiter.dev/arcade/retro-labyrinth): An abandoned codebase, now with corridors. Navigate moving walls, wield developer-themed weapons, and find the FaceForge boss in this browser roguelike.
- [Study Director: Everything Is Fine](https://deruiter.dev/arcade/study-director): Walk the floor of a CRO and run a clinical study from kickoff to closeout. Talk to your team, visit the sites, and defend your decisions to the FDA.
- [Trial & Error: Biostat Deckbuilder](https://deruiter.dev/arcade/trial-and-error): Clinical outputs are the cards. Review tables against the SAP, correct redlines for +Mult, and play Chips × Mult hands to beat the Blinds in this deckbuilder.
- [Working With Duck: Pet Sim Arcade](https://deruiter.dev/arcade/working-with-duck): You have a deadline. Duck the puppy has a ball. Keep the project and the puppy happy with toys, treats, and park breaks in this browser game.
- [Laser Loon Merch, Coming Soon](https://deruiter.dev/merch): Laser Loon stickers, shirts, desk mats, mugs and prints, planned at base production cost through Redbubble with no artist markup. The artwork is CC0.

## Case studies

- [Project Writeups and Case Studies](https://deruiter.dev/case-studies): Read about the problems, implementation choices, and lessons behind Fred de Ruiter’s clinical data tools, web apps, and side projects, with code on GitHub.
- [4Glory: Does Fred Know Ball?](https://deruiter.dev/case-studies/4glory): Does Fred know ball? Compare basketball opinions with Python and XGBoost predictions on NBA data, using rolling features, walk-forward validation, and SHAP.
- [Inspectable Cardiac Risk Models](https://deruiter.dev/case-studies/cardiac-risk-modeling): Read a cardiac risk modeling project using Python, XGBoost, and SHAP. Explore data leakage, cross-validation, calibration, and model explanations.
- [clintrials: Trial Designs in Browser](https://deruiter.dev/case-studies/clintrials): Compare adaptive clinical trial designs in a browser workspace. See how Pyodide workers run statistical models without a separate Python setup.
- [CRF.xl: Spreadsheet to Clinical Forms](https://deruiter.dev/case-studies/crf-xl): Turn Excel protocol grids into clinical form definitions and ODM-XML exports. Read how CRF.xl handles rules, dependencies, and background work.
- [Designing for My Brother: Typography](https://deruiter.dev/case-studies/designing-for-my-brother): A personal case study on cognitive typography: replacing generic fonts with Lexend, Atkinson Hyperlegible, and OpenDyslexic with zero-CLS Pretext reflow.
- [DuckDeploy: Config to Deployed Forms](https://deruiter.dev/case-studies/duckdeploy): Turn JSON Schema into configuration forms, then compile the values into deployment manifests. See how DuckDeploy uses TypeScript and workers.
- [Equipose: Trial Randomization](https://deruiter.dev/case-studies/equipose-randomization): Explore reproducible clinical trial randomization in the browser, with generated Python, R, SAS, and Stata code for inspecting the allocation.
- [Lambda-Wave: Respiratory Motion Radar](https://deruiter.dev/case-studies/lambda-wave): Explore respiratory motion tracking for surface guided radiation therapy using FMCW radar, Haskell signal processing, and C++ sample transport.
- [OxidizeMath: Rust Scientific Computing](https://deruiter.dev/case-studies/oxidizemath): Explore scientific computing in Rust with numerical solvers, compile-time checks, and interactive simulations. Read the OxidizeMath writeup.
- [PromptOps: Test Prompts Like Code](https://deruiter.dev/case-studies/promptops): Version prompts, validate response shapes, and run regression evaluations in CI. Read how PromptOps makes changes easier to inspect and compare.
- [Sonos Network Controller in Python](https://deruiter.dev/case-studies/sonos-network-controller): Control Sonos speakers on your own network with a Python API and a small web interface. Read about the protocols and implementation choices.
- [Laser Loon: Artwork & Downloads](https://deruiter.dev/work/laser-loon): Meet Laser Loon, my Minnesota flag submission, and download the artwork in print and web formats. The eye lasers are included in the download.

## Writing and contact

- [Engineering Dispatches: Blog](https://deruiter.dev/blog): Cross-project retrospectives and technique write-ups on clinical data engineering, formal verification, accessibility, and browser graphics by Fred de Ruiter.
- [Contact Fred: Builds, Bugs, Questions](https://deruiter.dev/contact): Working on something interesting, found an open-source bug, or have a clinical data question? Send Fred de Ruiter a note, or book a video chat to talk it over.
- [Book a 30-Minute Chat With Fred](https://deruiter.dev/schedule): Pick a time on Google Calendar to talk about a project, ask a question, or say hello. Each booking is a 30-minute Google Meet chat with Fred de Ruiter.

## Mobile and utility routes

- [Mobile CRF Studio for Clinical Forms](https://deruiter.dev/m/crf): Touch-optimized clinical research form studio designed for mobile viewports, enabling interactive section and field inspection on mobile devices.
- [Mobile NeuroRecon Studio Viewer](https://deruiter.dev/m/neuro): Touch-optimized neuroimaging structural morphometry viewer for mobile screens, providing subcortical volumetric metrics and FreeSurfer recon status.
- [Mobile Ski Patrol Shift Studio](https://deruiter.dev/m/patrol): Touch-optimized ski patrol operational judgment simulator built for mobile screens, allowing real-time triage and emergency intervention decisions.
- [Mobile Logical Proof Workspace](https://deruiter.dev/m/proof): Touch-optimized formal logic proof workspace tailored for handheld devices, offering interactive deduction step ledgers and fallacy diagnostics.
- [You’re Offline: Page Not Saved](https://deruiter.dev/offline): This page has not been saved for offline use. Check your connection, retry the page, or open one of the pages already cached in your browser.
